download_hf_dataset: download a HuggingFace dataset and materialize it as scenario JSON files cached locally
download_hf_dataset_with_splits: download specific splits of a HuggingFace dataset by passing a list of config names
download_hf_dataset_with_token: download a private HuggingFace dataset by providing an API token for authentication
is_hf_dataset: check if a string looks like a valid HuggingFace dataset ID in org/name format
is_hf_dataset_path_check: verify a dataset string is not a local file path before treating it as a HF dataset ID
